BiblicalUsage: Piram was the Amorite king of Jarmuth who joined the five kings against Gibeon. He is named once, in Joshua 10:3, when Adoni-zedek of Jerusalem sent for him — and the five kings together were defeated by Joshua, and hanged.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that kings who band together against God's people share one end.
RelatedEvents: The Sun Stands Still at Gibeon
